issues.description: Duplicate db.sh entry: file-level db.sh is both a symlink and adds a new variable
issues.detail: The PR creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh AND modifies TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh to add TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads. That's correct, but local/data.sh sources ./db.sh which resolves via the symlink. However, local/path.sh only sets MAIN_ROOT and is never sourced by run.sh's pipeline through asr.sh consistently; verify TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH actually propagates. If not exported in TEMPLATE/db.sh, the variable check fails.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh does not exit when unzip is missing or args are wrong
issues.detail: Lines 9-11 print an error if unzip is missing but do not exit. Lines 13-21 print usage on bad arg count but do not exit either. Execution then continues into realpath $1 with possibly unset/empty $1, causing confusing failures. Both branches must `exit 1` after printing.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: Lines 23-24: `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` and `zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir})` lack quotes around `$1`/`${2:-$extract_dir}`. With set -u and -e, a path containing spaces will either word-split into multiple args to realpath or fail. Quote them as `realpath "$1"` and `realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}"`.

issues.description: README links to a non-existent config path under conf/train/
issues.detail: README.md line 15 links to `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml`, but the actual file is at `conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (no `train/` subdir). The link in the README will 404 on GitHub and confuse anyone reproducing the recipe.

issues.description: data.sh sources path.sh from CWD but only local/path.sh exists with MAIN_ROOT only
issues.detail: data.sh runs `. ./path.sh` (line 16). Top-level path.sh is a symlink to TEMPLATE/asr1/path.sh (fine), but a separate local/path.sh exists that only sets MAIN_ROOT and is never used. The stray local/path.sh is dead code at best and misleading at worst; remove it or document its purpose.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts in data.sh will break if dataset is updated
issues.detail: local/data.sh lines 77-81 hard-code expected line counts (22467, 3208, 6072, 29386, 38924). Any reissue or filtering of the upstream TAL data will trip the `wc -l` guard and fail the recipe. Consider making the count check a warning, or document the exact dataset version in README so reviewers can pin it.

review.summary: This PR adds a standard ESPnet ASR recipe for TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH, mostly boilerplate (symlinks, configs) that follows existing conventions. Main concerns are in the data scripts: download_and_untar.sh has missing exits in error branches and unquoted command substitutions that break with set -euo pipefail; data.sh hard-codes utterance counts that will break on dataset updates; README links to a wrong config path; and a stray local/path.sh duplicates the top-level path.sh symlink. None of the issues affect ESPnet core code.
